Unique Research · Ranking · November 12, 2024 · Data window: Oct 1–31, 2024

Ingest note: CN article is board-image–heavy (~9 charts). EN keeps methodology, definitions, and board inventory. Attach original boards or redraw EN labels on import; do not invent company ranks not visible in CN images.

Board meta

  • Title: October 2024 AI Industry Boards｜Company
  • Publisher: Unique Research (非凡产研)
  • Sources: diversified hybrid; curated by Unique Research

Board inventory

  1. Global AI Company Unicorn TOP100 — ranked by latest post-money valuation in-month
  2. Global AI Company Revenue TOP100 — ranked by estimated annual revenue
  3. Global AI Company Valuation Growth TOP100 — ranked by valuation growth rate
  4. China AI Company Attention TOP50 — ranked by aggregate product visit duration
  5. China AI Product Coverage TOP100 — ranked by WEB+APP MAU
  6. Global AI WEB Subscription TOP100 — subscription revenue only (ex ads, transaction commissions, one-off professional services)
  7. Global AI WEB Subscription Growth TOP100 — MoM subscription change
  8. Global AI APP Bestseller TOP100 — IAP revenue (ex ads, direct pay, third-party Android)
  9. Global AI APP Bestseller Growth TOP100 — MoM IAP change

Tracking universe

Independent Unique Research coverage of thousands of AI companies and ~10k AI products. Companion APP boards (downloads, MAU, duration, bestsellers — global / domestic / outbound) published separately.

Research statement (abridged)

Collection: multi-source traffic + proprietary processing, labeled/classified by Unique Research.

Scope: WEB & APP on PC/tablet/phone only — not plugins, desktop software, mini-programs, Discord, local open-source. Focus on products with >10k monthly visits; TOP30/50/100 cuts.

Use: research reference, not investment advice. Cite Unique Research; charts: Unique Research data + Unique Research charts.

Geography: Overseas = non-Chinese founders, global markets; Domestic = Chinese founders, China market; Outbound = Chinese/Chinese-diaspora founders, non-China primary markets.

Product types: AI-native (core value depends on AI); AI-feature (AI added to existing product); AI-ecosystem (platforms connecting builders/users).

WEB metrics: Visits, Unique Visitors, Visit Duration. APP: Downloads, Sessions (re-open <5s = one), Active Users, Duration Time.

Org: Unique Research is Unique Capital’s research arm on new-business innovation, China & outbound enterprise services, and AI × traditional industries.

— END —
